description:
What changed here, as JSON. Two ways to read it.

The cursor feed (send `kinds`, or `cursor`): everything that changed, oldest first, readable to the end without gaps: decisions added or changed, provisions with a new text (new Fassung, new provision, new law), and new citation links (decision X now cites Y, or decision Y gained a citer). Start with `kinds` (and `since`, default 7 days ago), then pass `next_cursor` back unchanged, with the same filters, until `has_more` is false; keep the cursor and poll with it later.

Without those arguments: the provisions that got a new text recently, newest first. Poll it with `since` set to the newest `observed` you have processed.

`observed` / `observed_at` is when the change reached this service, not when a court decided or a law came into force. Say so if you report a date. The window is the last 120 days; a provision's own history is listNormVersions.

court.description: Cursor feed: a court, as the court segment of a decision URL (bgh).

cursor.description: Cursor feed: `next_cursor` of the previous call, unchanged.

kinds.description: Cursor feed: which kinds (decision, law, citation).

land.description: Cursor feed: a Land code (BY, NW, SN, BB, ...) or BUND.

law.description: Cursor feed: a law abbreviation (BGB). Leaves out links between decisions.

since.description: Only changes observed on or after this date (cursor feed: at most 120 days back, default 7).

name: getChanges
title: Change Feed
